listing.name: Sonic Advance / SAT-R sa2 repository
listing.summary: Sonic Advance 1 source project sharing a repository with Sonic Advance 2. Its documented sa1.gba output is a GBA ROM; the sa2 SDL commands do not establish this title's native player. Native registration requires a separately prepared native Sonic Advance 1 copy.

steps.title: Prepare upstream or keep an existing game build
steps.instruction: This shared repository contains Sonic Advance 1 and 2. Use the Sonic Advance 1 source/edition instructions; its listed sa1.gba output is a GBA ROM, not a native PC executable. The README’s sa2 SDL commands describe Sonic Advance 2 and do not establish this game’s native output. Only select an existing native Sonic Advance 1 player if you have separately prepared one; keep the title-specific native-build question explicit.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Keep the game in a separate folder you control, and retain a working copy. Review its executable in Portcove, then add it without changing its files. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external copy. Follow the project’s instructions for the version you use when changing it.
